ITEM 1 | Thin green beans, bright to medium green with slightly darker tips, lightly cooked with a slightly glossy, limp texture, bundled in a loose heap of roughly 15-18 cm long pieces with a few stem ends visible, piled in the upper-center of the plate covering about 30% of the plate's surface and standing about 2 cm high | 85

ITEM 2 | Mixed loose salad leaves, mostly bright green with some darker purplish-red edged leaves, crisp-looking but wilted, flat and folded, spread across the lower and right side of the plate covering about 45% of the surface and piled about 1 cm high, with no dressing or sheen visible | 60
